tables.sectionText:
PRIZES AND ODDS

During each hourly drawing1, five winning numbers2 will be selected. Prizes3 and odds vary based on the number of sequential numbers matched.

Match	Prize	Odds
All 5 Digits	$5,000	1 in 100,000
First 4 Digits	$500	1 in 11,111.1
First 3 Digits	$200	1 in 1,111.1
First 2 Digits	$20	1 in 111.1
First Digits	$2	1 in 11.1


The overall odds of winning a prize is 1 in 10. 

DISCLAIMERS:

1 5 In-A-Line can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week with the first draw time at 4:30 AM. Players have until 11:59 PM Arizona time on each day to purchase 5 In-A-Line tickets. The last drawing for 5 In-A-Line will be at 11:30 PM Arizona time.

2 Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

3 Prizes will be pari-mutuel when the total prize for matching 5/5 with 5X multiplier drawn is above $25,000. The total prize shall be split into equal shares, one share for each winning $1.00 played, rounded down to the nearest dollar. The prize amount per winner is the prize amount per share times the bet amount.

4 All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
5 IN-A-LINE
Step 1,
Pick Your Numbers

This game is Quick Pick only. Five numbers will be randomly generated for you:

Five numbers, each from 0 - 9
Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Each play costs $1. You also have the option to add Super Bonus for $1 per play for a chance to multiply your prize up to 5X.

Your ticket will print with your Quick Pick numbers on it.

Tickets can be purchased1 at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match the numbers on your ticket in the same order as the winning numbers selected.
